name: teach-resonance-playing
about: Re-check: a guided lock while playing lands on its step.

steps.say: make a bassline on track 3 and play it

did it work?

name: soft-fill
about: Re-check: a fill merged into a soft beat keeps its velocity.

steps.say: make a soft 4 bar beat, everything at velocity 70
add a snare fill in bar 4

name: slow-build
about: Re-check: a slow scene heard whole, every bar.

steps.say: make a 4 bar beat at 85 bpm that builds up bar by bar
does it really build? listen and tell me

name: tom-descend
about: Re-check: toms by number, high to low.

steps.say: make a beat
add a fill in the last bar going down the toms, high to low

name: snappier-snare
about: Re-check: one generated sound, the rest kept.

steps.say: make a beat
generate a snappier snare for it, keep the rest of the kit
